items.title: Arista Networks (ANET) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift After Analyst Revisions
items.summary: Arista Networks is back in focus after analysts updated price targets across the stock, with moves ranging from a cut to US$236 from US$289 to new targets as high as US$261. These shifts follow Q3 results and fresh 2026 and 2027 guidance, as analysts weigh AI related networking demand, long term growth assumptions, and what they are prepared to pay for that profile.
